_doc: GrabCut seed sweep, 2026-09-02. For every row of testset/gt/gutter.json, pipeline.book_boundary.find_book (the SHIPPED detector as of commit c88e580, i.e. one unseeded GrabCut draw) was run eight times in one process with cv2.setRNGSeed(s) for s in 0..7 immediately before the call, and the shipped gutter search was run inside its search box. Fields per draw: applied, emit/search boxes (original px), emit_source, emit_area_frac, gutter (original px, None = no split), method, hit (within gutter.json tolerance), clip (% of the labelled book outside the emitted crop, None where book_box.json has no label), reason. PROVENANCE OF THE de_01/de_02 ROWS: their graded anchors live in gitignored jobs/orient_fix_de*, which this machine does not have, so those two rows were run on the committed testset/de_01.jpg / de_02.jpg (EXIF ignored, already upright). The book_box.json label fits de_02.jpg by eye at 1000 px wide (overlay drawn and inspected), but pixel identity with the Stage 01 anchor is NOT established, so the de_* numbers here are a finding about the committed frames, not a re-grade of the split_eval rows. Everything else is byte-identical to what split_eval grades. Machine: 4-core Linux container, OpenCV 5.0.0, no GPU. See docs/RESULTS.md 2026-09-02.
